P0 (independent, do before any gate work; each verified against main 76cf0e88):
1. LAND DA-1: merge/re-land 2c5784dea to main — main's sync-rules.ps1 still has plain Copy-Item -Force with no backup-guard. Until merged, treat "the destroy-class is dead" as false for fresh clones, CI, and estate-sync VM bootstrap.
2. -Report write defect: prefer the estate-native pattern over the design's convoluted boolean — introduce an explicit -Apply switch (deploy-skills-daily.py precedent: dry-run by default, --self-test before write) so 'sync' mode requires a deliberate verb; the one-line guard is a stopgap.

STRUCTURAL PATCHES (each maps to a worst-case leg):

P1 — Pin semantics must be direction-symmetric and decision-owned (kills the laundered-pin chain):
- A pinned path is frozen for BOTH directions: pull-mode LIVE-EDITED on a pinned path queues a fold-back CANDIDATE (with pull-side evidence appended to the existing SG row) instead of auto-applying. Auto-apply (keep-live) is permitted only for never-pinned paths.
- Baseline updates (B:=R adoption) require an explicit disposition act (interactive K, or -Apply with a decisions file carrying an actor identity) — never a nightly default. Dispositions record actor (user vs agent parent-process); agent-authored decisions pre-fill but never auto-apply on later runs; bulk -Apply over N divergent items (suggest N=20) must split into batches with per-batch confirmation (habituation countermeasure: Vance et al. fMRI 2018 — variation/randomization defeats warning habituation; Bravo-Lillo CMU thesis; SOUPS 2019 "Fog of Warnings").

P2 — Close the encoding-phantom gap BEFORE piloting (kills the permanent-conflict generator):
- Extend normalization: add BOM-ONLY (strip UTF-8 BOM pre-normalized-hash) and ENCODING-ONLY (BOM-sniff UTF-16LE, decode, compare code points) classes; refine the NUL-scan Binary flag so ASCII-range UTF-16 text is not masked as unnormalizable binary. MEASURE the phantom rate on the real trees first (the CRLF 16.8% precedent: measure, then classify). Detector self-control gains planted BOM and UTF-16 fixtures.

P3 — Fold-back must never stage into the shared index (kills the index-sweep/autopush leg):
- Pull-mode apply and K-dispositions write files plus a machine-readable fold-back manifest; staging happens only in a dedicated worktree/branch (repo already ships scripts/worktree-isolation/ + hooks/create-worktree.ps1) or via a scoped git add executed at commit time with the manifest as the allowlist. sync-from-live's dirty-index refusal already treats staged state as abnormal — keep that invariant; leaving staged bytes overnight under mandatory autopush is a loaded gun.

P4 — Register hygiene (kills the flood/false-open leg):
- One SG row per pinned-path-SET (keyed by sorted-path hash), AMENDED on re-queue (bump review-by, run-count, last-seen), not appended per run; auto-CLOSE with evidence on disposition; an age/severity bucket feeds a statusline open-SG count — promote the design's P4 statusline from optional to required at P3. Validate the row format against the live gap_check.py header mapping (gap-check lives in the ~/.agents tree, not the repo — I could not read it remotely: UNVERIFIED, though consistent with AGENTS-RUNTIME's header-mapped description).

P5 — Close or explicitly fence the fifth hop:
- deploy-skills-daily.py + ci/check_skill_deploy_drift.py already run classify-and-refuse over repo .agents/skills -> ~/.claude/skills.daily with a measured 431-file needs_merge standing backlog. Either teach it the shared pin registry (it is Python; have it read pending/*.json + baseline) or declare skills.daily out of scope AND import its needs_merge count into the SG register so the owner sees ONE reconciliation number. Map its vocabulary onto the matrix (RIGHT-AHEAD ~= UPGRADE, DIVERGED ~= CONFLICT) to avoid a second taxonomy.

P6 — Deploy-stall safety for executable trees:
- For PYTHONPATH-loaded skill paths (workflow-monitor class), a pin must not mean silent stall: either deploy repo-ahead content under a versioned suffix with the pin surfaced, or raise those SG rows to severity A plus a weekly stale-deploy census — the WF-5 measured class (stale monitor code, CI-invisible) makes uncounted stalls unacceptable on this subtree.

P7 — Probe and lint honesty:
- Confirm lint-rules-loading.ps1's actual location and semantics (not in repo scripts/ at main HEAD: UNVERIFIED); it must compare hashes, not existence, or the green-freeze state hides behind a green lint. Add a weekly full -Drift census committed as an artifact (second signal per the estate's own single-signal-verification rule).

P8 — Exit-2 consumers:
- Do not invent new cron alerting; wire exit 2 into the existing skill-dual-write CI lane and the statusline. Scheduled-task wrappers must treat 2 as success-with-pending (not failure) to avoid retry loops churning quarantine retention (20 runs/30 days is also too short for REPLACED live bytes — replaced-side quarantine should persist until disposition plus a 90-day grace).

Scope honesty that must ship with the gate: even patched, this manages divergence forever instead of eliminating the two-copy class. Label the gate interim scaffolding for the overlay/drop-in endgame (openSUSE /usr/etc-style layering for the hottest files) — otherwise it entrenches the copy architecture it was built to police, and the existing skill-tree-reconcile skill remains the human-driven equivalent it should call rather than duplicate.

attacks.worst_case:
THE LAUNDERED PIN AND THE GREEN FREEZE (composite; every link is either disk/API-verified on this estate or carries a measured precedent).

Verified substrate first (GitHub API reads of Prekzursil/agent-skills-toolchain @ main 76cf0e88, 2026-09-30T17:30Z):
- sync-from-live.ps1 default-branch code confirms the P0 defect exactly: `$writeAllowed = (-not $WhatIf -and -not $Drift)` — `-Report json` WITHOUT -Drift runs mode 'sync' and WRITES while emitting machine JSON. CONFIRMED (95%+).
- The two-writer overlap is real: sync-from-live's $Map pulls ALL of live ~/.claude/rules -> repo rules/, while sync-rules.ps1 pushes repo rules/common -> live ~/.claude/rules/common. Both-changed is first-class. CONFIRMED.
- sync-skills.ps1: Remove-Item -Recurse -Force per skill + -Prune orphan deletion, and its own docstring adds a fact the design missed: live ~/.agents/skills is ON PYTHONPATH for running monitors (mon.cmd -> workflow-monitor), with the measured WF-5 incident (live monitorcore 37 modules vs repo 38; deploy lag structurally invisible to CI/vendordrift). CONFIRMED.
- CRITICAL SCOPE GAP the design missed entirely: there is a FIFTH hop — scripts/deploy-skills-daily.py (repo .agents/skills -> ~/.claude/skills.daily, "the ONE tree Claude Code reads") with its own classify-and-refuse engine (ci/check_skill_deploy_drift.py; RIGHT-AHEAD / DIVERGED / needs_merge) and a MEASURED standing backlog of 431 files needing human merge (2026-08-12). A permanent never-dispositioned queue is not a hypothetical residual on this estate — it is the CURRENT steady state, one hop away from the loaded tree.
- The DA-1 backup-guard the whole directive builds on is NOT on main: commit 2c5784dea (2026-09-30T20:32Z, +9 lines to sync-rules.ps1) postdates main HEAD 76cf0e88 (17:30Z) and is absent from it — the fix lives on an unmerged branch. Fresh clones, CI, and the offload-VM estate-sync bootstrap all get the UNGUARDED corpse-class sync-rules today. CONFIRMED via API.

The chain (3am, headless, unpatched design):
1. A recurring Windows PowerShell 5.1-style writer (`>` / Out-File default UTF-16LE+BOM, or Set-Content -Encoding utf8 leaving a BOM; corroborated across Microsoft Learn about_Character-Encoding, SuperUser 327492, StackOverflow 40098771) rewrites a hot live file (rule, hook manifest, SKILL.md). The promoted Get-NormalizedHash strips ONLY CR-before-LF; the BOM/UTF-16 phantom has NO benign class (UTF-16's NUL bytes even set Binary=true, so normalization is never attempted). The 16.8% CRLF-phantom incident is this exact disease, unmeasured sibling. The file classifies CONFLICT forever.
2. sync-rules queues it: SG register row, pending.json, quarantine, PIN. Deploys of that path stall. Lint stays green. Nobody dispositions at 3am.
3. Next nightly run, sync-from-live sees the SAME path as LIVE-EDITED in pull direction = AUTO-APPLY per design section 7: live bytes copied over the repo copy, STAGED in the shared toolchain index, baseline B:=R. The pin dissolves with NO disposition act; the SG row stays OPEN (false-open). The design's "pinned = DO-NOT-TOUCH for every script" is contradicted by its own pull-mode auto-apply — the pin mechanism is self-erasing across directions.
4. An unrelated parallel agent commits; the estate's MEASURED shared-index contamination (68-file sweep, MEMORY.md incident) folds the staged bytes into that commit; the mandatory fail-open autopush post-commit hook pushes instantly.
5. The other machine (or any fresh clone): repo moved, live untouched -> UPGRADE class -> the laundered unreviewed bytes deploy silently estate-wide. One phantom-conflict file became a pushed, cross-machine "reconciliation" with all receipts pointing the wrong way.
6. The recurring writer regenerates the divergence next session: new SG row per nightly run -> register flood -> gap-check nags every session -> habituation (corroborated: Bravo-Lillo CMU; Vance et al. fMRI 2018; SOUPS 2019 Fog of Warnings — general notification volume trains users to ignore the real warning).
7. In parallel, pinned skill paths stall deploys while mon.cmd keeps PYTHONPATH-loading stale monitor code — WF-5 returns structurally, invisible to CI.

Damage: no irrecoverable loss (quarantine + git history make both directions reversible-with-receipts), but the owner's core ask — divergence CONFRONTED before overwrite — is silently violated by direction-asymmetric auto-apply; unreviewed content is laundered into main and autopushed cross-machine; the reconciliation surfaces emit false-opens and floods (the estate's own measured never-gating-suite rot); and code-executing trees run stale. Fatal-if-unpatched for the directive's intent, but every leg has a concrete patch.

attacks.patched_design_notes:
MANDATORY BEFORE PHASE 3 (patch the worst-case limbs; each mapped to the cascade step it kills):

P1. FOLD STABILITY GATE (kills limb 2-3, the core defect). Auto-fold must require ALL of: (a) two-sighting rule — identical projection hash across two consecutive verify runs separated by >=1h (a hash that keeps changing between scans is in-flight by definition); (b) mtime age >= 48h on the projection (fresh = probably mid-work); (c) the SAME semantic verify-probe materialize already specifies (frontmatter/JSON parse, hooks dispatch-manifest loads, check-index-freshness for skills) run on the fold SOURCE bytes before the commit. Any failure -> OPEN-LOOPS row, never a fold. This is tripwire's accept-as-new-baseline done with a stability proof instead of a single sample. Also fixes the attribution sin: auto-fold's classification is always "progress"; with the gate, an agent's abandoned experiment (W9) ages out into a reviewable row instead of being laundered into SSOT.

P2. MANIFEST FAIL-CLOSED + ROW-LEVEL MERGE (kills limb 4's amplifier). Every manifest read: schema + self-digest validation; unparseable/partial manifest -> verify exit 1 (the design's own detector-failure class), auto-fold GLOBALLY disabled until re-baselined; recovery is a git checkout of the last committed manifest (it is committed — use that). A missing-row flood classifies as manifest-suspect, NOT UNMANAGED-LIVE (else it feeds the habituation poison). Single-writer mutex Windows-style: FileMode.CreateNew lockfile + PID liveness + stale-break (no flock exists); manifest updates are row-level last-writer-wins keyed on path so interleaved runs converge. PROBED: ~/.agents/.gitignore currently has NO .mat/stage entries — add ~/.agents/.mat/ to .gitignore AND to the nightly autocommit pathspec exclusions, or the autocommit lane commits staging garbage.

P3. TERMINATING DISPOSITIONS FOR HEADLESS (kills limb 5, the 3am deadlock). The PreToolUse exit-2 block message must carry the machine-executable escape, not prose: "run: harness-edit <path>". harness-edit needs autonomous disposition verbs (--adopt-live / --keep-source / --defer), each writing provenance (session id, verify runid) into the decision commit, so a headless agent can ALWAYS terminate a pinned-path loop instead of burning its turn budget retrying a block. W3's circular trap (edit blocked -> harness-edit -> materialize pinned -> retry) has no exit today; this is it.

P4. TTL ESCALATION, NOT TTL DELETION (kills the evidence-destruction amplifier). .mat/gen-* expiry fires ONLY for rows with a recorded disposition; undisputed displaced bytes never expire silently — expiry of undisputed bytes CREATES an OPEN-LOOPS row with review-by (gap-check then holds the loop). As specified, the TTL quietly reintroduces a scheduled destroy-class — the .bak-corpse problem with a timer.

STRONGLY RECOMMENDED:

P5. STATUSLINE MUST NEVER RUN VERIFY. Wire drift:N to a cached verdict file stamped by the last verify/cron run; a pwsh spawn + managed-set scan every 30s statusline tick is a real RAM/CPU tax in the 2026-09-19 commit-exhaustion freeze profile. Drift:N is as fresh as the last cron tick — fine.

P6. NIGHTLY AUTOCOMMIT RESOURCE GATE. The 2026-09-19 measured freeze was COMMIT-driven on a large checkout under concurrent load — exactly this lane's profile. Run only in the measured idle window AND behind a mem%/busy gate. (UNVERIFIED at probed path: estate-context.py / gap_check.py not found at toolchain scripts/ depth 3; settings.json hook events PreToolUse/PostToolUse/Stop exist — resolve script paths before depending on them, per AGENTS-RUNTIME citations.)

P7. PHASE-0 ORDERING FIX. Drift inventory + per-path dispositions BEFORE the 1067-commit merge, never during it; merge conflicts default live-wins (adopt-present) with toolchain-side wins requiring an explicit disputed row. Otherwise the reconcile merge itself can commit the silent-regression sin the design exists to kill. Phase 0 is the schedule risk, not a design risk — budget it honestly (days, not hours).

P8. HABITUATION GUARDS. UNMANAGED-LIVE counted separately from drift:N so the segment can reach 0; stray-file rows get periodic disposition review (orphan-hoarding is orphan-prune inverted). Phase-1 tuning must have authority to REMOVE paths from the managed set: any path with sustained unexplained drift arrival is mis-enumerated by definition — a detector firing on legitimate runtime writes is a false-positive generator.

P9. SWAP MECHANICS HARDENING (minor, corroborated 2 engines: Stack Overflow q/167414 + MS Learn MoveFileExA). Set MOVEFILE_WRITE_THROUGH; same-volume atomicity is effective but not doc-guaranteed and cross-volume moves silently degrade to copy+delete — assert stage dir and target are same volume, else abort.

VERDICT RATIONALE: The architecture (one writable source per surface inside a git tree, persisted hash baseline, generated projections, mechanical four-state verdicts, no-deletion-without-disposition, per-path scoping, phased enforcement) is the converged SOTA pattern and the estate is already ~80% of that topology per my own probes. Every identified failure is a patchable mechanic, not a structural flaw; the phase gating (measure-before-enforce) bounds blast radius during rollout. The design as WRITTEN has one genuine defect (fold-side TOCTOU with zero validation before an autopushed SSOT commit) and one deadlock (no terminating disposition for headless agents on pinned paths) — both patched above.
attacks.worst_case:
THE SILENT SSOT POISONING CASCADE (composite, all limbs estate-realistic, 3am headless).

Setup verified by my own probes this session: ~/.agents IS a live git checkout (branch live-capture/2026-09-02, 121 ahead / 1067 behind origin/main, 145 dirty paths — matches the design's 120/1067/150 within session drift; the environment header's "not a git repository" was a harness-detection artifact); the four sync scripts exist; the .bak-20260930-234450 corpse is real; ~/.claude has no .git; 422 live skills; commit 2c5784dea (backup-guard) confirmed in toolchain history; PreToolUse/PostToolUse/Stop hooks exist in settings.json.

The cascade: (1) 03:10, a headless workflow agent is mid-edit on a managed projection (~/.claude/rules/common/x.md) via a NON-atomic writer (PowerShell Set-Content truncate-then-write, or python json.dump — the EXACT measured 2026-09-29 partial-json.dump class that destroyed .claude.json keys); the nightly harness-verify samples the file while on-disk bytes are truncated/half-written. (2) The four-state matrix reads source==manifest, projection!=manifest -> LIVE-EDIT -> auto-fold fires. CRITICAL DEFECT: the design's TOCTOU re-hash guard exists ONLY on the materialize side (2.3); the fold side (2.2) has NO stability check, NO re-read, and NO semantic validation before committing. (3) The truncated bytes are committed to the SSOT as "fold: x.md (live edit adopted)" and autopushed immediately (ALWAYS-PUSH). (4) The next materialize deploys the truncated rule — or worse, a hook/dispatch-manifest file whose JSON no longer parses, which is load-bearing for the box's own fail-open hook wrapping — to every projection and (via project.ps1 regeneration) into CI-visible repo surfaces. (5) Morning state: drift:N = 0 because everything is "IN-SYNC" — with garbage; gap-check is silent because no OPEN-LOOPS row exists (nothing failed); statusline is green. The system's core virtue — mechanical, silent-when-clean reconciliation — becomes the amplification channel: a transient partial write is laundered into the versioned source of truth and propagated cross-machine with ZERO surviving signal. Silence is only safe when in-sync implies good; this cascade makes in-sync mean "consistently corrupted".

AMPLIFIERS: (a) Concurrent verify+materialize runs (nightly cron + an interactive agent's harness-edit at 3am — Windows has no flock; per-runid staging exists but the manifest read-modify-write can interleave, stranding stale rows that manufacture later LIVE-EDIT/CONFLICT verdicts and, worse, corrupt the manifest itself — and a corrupt manifest is the keystone every verdict derives from). (b) The .mat/gen-* TTL: displaced bytes age out on a timer, so the only surviving evidence of what was overwritten before anyone disputes it can be deleted by the system itself — the ".bak corpse" problem reintroduced as a scheduled destroy-class. (c) Fold of an agent's abandoned live experiment (mtime-agnostic auto-fold) permanently launders scratch state into pushed SSOT with no adjudication — the design's own philosophy (divergence must be classified progress/regression/unknown) is violated by its most autonomous verb, whose classification is always "progress". Probability this cascade or a close variant occurs within 6 months if Phase 3 ships as written: likely (Sherman-Kent ~65-75%) — every ingredient is estate-measured except the wiring, and the partial-write writer class is proven present.

attacks.patched_design_notes:
P1 (patch of W1-W2 — the load-bearing one): fold-back is NEVER headless-automatic. The design's own manifest sketch says `"foldback_headless": "gate"` while its matrix says auto — internal contradiction; resolve to gate. Headless runs may APPLY repo→live (curated direction, keeps deploys un-bricked, matching the autopush fail-open precedent) but may fold back ONLY files passing a QUIESCE gate: last-write mtime older than 24-48h AND no live agent session on the tree (recent-activity probe in ~/.claude/projects, or a session heartbeat). Anything hot parks as a distinct WIP class (not "conflict"). Rename the mechanical class: live≠base is LIVE-EDITED-provenance-unknown; parse-level validity proves non-garbage, not goodness. Classification is not reconciliation (owner's words); kubectl itself never pushes live→manifest headlessly. LLM annotator stays advisory-only per the design's own §6.

P2 (patch of W4): the manifest is a CACHE, not the truth. Write atomic (temp+rename on same volume) + keep last-good manifest.bak + journal every transition append-only to runs/ with fsync BEFORE any target write (write-ahead: undo.json and journal precede the first write, not follow the run). On load: schema-validate; on parse failure: rebuild from journal + content-addressed blobs (the design's own blob property, unused as written); if a path can't be reconstructed, that path degrades to kubectl's SAFE no-base (park, one summary row) — never base:=repo. Pin sync-state/ under a root NO script's scope glob owns.

P3 (patch of W5): rename failures on sharing violation get bounded retry-with-backoff then per-file park as LOCKED and the run CONTINUES (fail-open for the run, fail-closed for the file — the autopush pattern); abort never leaves half-state. Startup sees journal-without-manifest-commit and completes forward (idempotent, content-addressed) or rolls back from undo.

P4 (patch of W6): lock = exclusively-opened FileStream (FileShare.None) carrying owner PID+start-time+heartbeat — existence-check locks are racy on Windows; stale detection = PID-not-alive or heartbeat age; on stale-break, one loop-row note. All FOUR scripts share ONE lock per tree (they overlap on ~/.agents roots), not per-script locks.

P5 (patch of W3): register discipline. Loop-rows idempotent, keyed path+class; re-detected items UPDATE (bump review-by, link latest run-id) instead of minting; cap ~50 active rows with overflow into one summary row; hard requirement: a quiet tree = exit 0 + zero register churn. Anti-habituation per Brustoloni (polymorphic dialogs, SOUPS 2007: varying the confrontation surface resists reflexive dismissal — dl.acm.org/doi/10.1145/1280680.1280691): -Resolve must show the actual three-way --diff3 per item (base hunk + both edits + a banded recommendation), never a generic "resolve" prompt; keep frequency low because a gate that fires nightly trains dismissal (Anderson et al. CHI 2016, dl.acm.org/doi/10.1145/3025453.3025896; "The Fog of Warnings", MIS Quarterly 2025, habituation generalizes across notification classes).

P6 (patch of W1-coupling): coherence sets. If any file in a run parks CONFLICT/UNKNOWN, sibling files diverged in the same time-window (mtime clustering, or an explicit change-set manifest written by editing agents) are held in the same park; fold-backs batch into ONE run-scoped commit and park-anywhere downgrades the whole fold-back batch. Never leave a tree state no side ever had.

P7 (plumbing, verified): git merge-file has NO --output flag — output requires redirection (git-scm.com/docs/git-merge-file, primary) — so capture git stdout as BYTES ([Process] StandardOutput.BaseStream → file or cmd /c redirect); PS5.1 redirection is UTF-16 = fatal mojibake, PS7 UTF-8-no-BOM is still pipeline-reencoded — the estate windows-shell.md footgun class. Add a deterministic fixture: merge non-ASCII + CRLF + marker-containing files, byte-compare. Conflict count truncates at 127 — treat any positive as "conflicted," never arithmetic on it.

P8 (exit-code contract): ship the cron wrapper with v1 — existing wrappers treat nonzero as generic failure and retry-storm. Exit 1 (machinery sick: IO/parse/lock) pages DIFFERENTLY from exit 2 (estate diverged); add a per-path suppression window.

P9 (bootstrap reality): a diverged-tree first run parks hundreds — provide scoped bulk dispositions (`-AdoptScope <glob> -Side live|repo`, one confirmation per scope) or adoption never happens and the destructive legacy scripts survive "temporarily" forever — which is the real kill risk: coexistence means divergence is recorded then destroyed by the legacy lane anyway. Physically replace all four old destructive paths (Remove-Item prune, sync-from-live deletions, writing -Report) in the same change or shim them to the new engine.

P10 (ship-gate chaos battery, must-prove before cutover): (a) kill the process at every phase boundary — next run converges or parks, never misclassifies; (b) concurrent sync-rules + sync-skills on overlapping trees; (c) manifest truncation injection → journal rebuild; (d) 3am simulation: hot mtimes + live sessions → ZERO fold-backs, only WIP parks; (e) sharing-violation injection mid-Apply; (f) 30 quiet nights → zero register churn.

UNVERIFIED (probe at implementation): `code --wait --merge` exact arg order (designer flagged; not re-verified); VS Code merge-editor presence on estate; chezmoi merge three-way internals (lane-sourced, not re-run this session); PowerShell redirection byte-fidelity for git stdout (fixture test P7 settles it). Estate-internal facts (RAM/commit freezes, 422 skills, autopush fail-open, 2026-09-29 partial-json.dump) taken as given from the task brief and estate memory, not re-measured.
attacks.verdict: SHIP-WITH-CHANGES. The three-way-merge-with-base architecture is the right skeleton — it is the only candidate design that mechanically detects REGRESSION via base history and makes silence state-earned (kubectl last-applied precedent, corroborated) — and none of the red-team failures are architectural; all are default-value and protocol defects. But as WRITTEN it is unshippable on three counts, each fatal-if-unpatched: (1) headless PROGRESS auto fold-back + autopush turns a classification guess into a remotely-published repo mutation at 3am (P1: quiesce gate + foldback_headless=gate default, non-negotiable); (2) the manifest is a single non-crash-consistent file holding the entire base truth, directly downstream of the estate's measured partial-write kill class (P2/P3: journal + atomic + rebuild-from-blobs + write-ahead undo); (3) per-run register rows train habituated dismissal and destroy the exact reconciliation surface the owner demanded (P5). Confidence: highly likely (0.85-0.92) that with P1-P4 + P7 landed and the P10 chaos battery green, the design holds on this estate; without P1 alone the verdict would be KILL. Ship gate: P1-P4 + P7 mandatory in v1; P5-P6 v1.1; P8-P9 gate the cutover, not the design.
attacks.worst_case:
WORST REALISTIC FAILURE — "the 3am PROGRESS cascade, then the gate is trained to be ignored, then the base dies halfway" (a composite chain; every link is a measured estate behavior or a corroborated tool semantic).

Phase 1 (trigger): An overnight 50-100-agent workflow is live at 3am. Agents routinely edit live trees mid-session (measured: 422 live skills, agents edit live configs during sessions). One agent process is killed mid-write (the 2026-09-29 partial-json.dump class), leaving a hook file syntactically parseable but semantically broken, plus dozens of legitimately half-finished WIP edits.

Phase 2 (misclassification — the core defect): cron sync runs. For every hot file: repo==base, live!=base => classified PROGRESS (parse-level validity passes — proving non-garbage, not goodness) => the design's §2 matrix AUTO-executes fold-back live->repo as a git commit, and the autopush post-commit hook pushes it immediately. The base advances to the WIP/half-broken state. The REGRESSION detector cannot fire: live bytes are novel hashes, not exact reverts in history. The owner's directive said divergence must be reconciled-or-disputed BEFORE any sync; this design guesses ("probably progress") and overwrites the repo — the destroy-class returning through the back door: it destroys the repo's role as curated truth rather than destroying bytes, so nothing fails loudly.

Phase 3 (propagation): the pushed state classifies as SIMPLE-UPGRADE on the next run on any other machine (repo!=base, live==base) and is applied. Breakage is now cross-machine; the only clean copy sits behind an autopushed commit chain (reflog-recoverable, but nothing is red, so nobody looks).

Phase 4 (gate floods -> habituation): the both-changed files park; exit 2; OPEN-LOOPS mints rows per parked file per run with no dedupe. Night after night on hot trees the register fills; gap-check injects every session with walls of expired review-bys. HCI verdict is unambiguous: repeated static prompts get reflexive dismissal — Brustoloni & Villamarin-Salomon SOUPS 2007 (dl.acm.org/doi/10.1145/1280680.1280691), Anderson et al. CHI 2016 fMRI+eye-tracking, habituation sets in after ~10 exposures (dl.acm.org/doi/10.1145/3025453.3025896); "The Fog of Warnings" (MIS Quarterly) shows habituation generalizes across notification classes. The one row that matters (real data loss) hides at position 43 of the spam.

Phase 5 (the base dies): RAM-pressure kill (estate: box freezes on COMMIT, Event 2004) truncates manifest.json mid-write. Next run: base gone for every path. Exactly kubectl's documented no-base degradation — when last-applied-configuration is missing/stripped, apply cannot detect deletions and miscomputes the merge (corroborated: kevinwelter.com, blog.werf.io 3-way merge writeup, portworx-forum error text). If the tempting recovery "base := repo" is coded, EVERY live-only edit reclassifies to PROGRESS and mass-folds-back live state (including agent WIP) into one commit; if it parks instead, exit 2 with hundreds of rows amplifies Phase 4.

Phase 6 (stale lock): the killed process leaves the .lock file (no flock on Windows). Fail-closed: the sync silently never runs again — a bricked sync, the exact inversion of the autopush fail-open precedent. Fail-open: sync-rules and sync-skills interleave read-modify-write on one manifest and drop each other's rows.

Phase 7 (Windows mid-run collision): a Stop hook or AV/indexer holds a target open without FILE_SHARE_DELETE (verified: MoveFileEx/replace needs DELETE access; any non-sharing handle => ERROR_SHARING_VIOLATION — learn.microsoft.com/windows/win32/fileio/moving-and-replacing-files, devblogs.microsoft.com/oldnewthing/20211022-00, github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/114230). The atomic rename throws; the run aborts halfway; undo.json (if written at run end) never lands; disk != manifest != repo; the next run misclassifies against a stale base.

Single worst moment, named: Phase 2+3 — headless PROGRESS auto-fold-back pushes a half-written live state, advances the base to it, and propagates it cross-machine with zero loud failure, while Phase 4 guarantees the confrontation surface has been trained into wallpaper.

converge.classification_vocab:
Refined into three separated layers — the single most important change is demoting "progress" from an auto-classification to a disposition output, because all three red-team worst cases ran through the same wire: "machine calls it progress -> machine writes it" (RT2: "auto-fold's classification is always progress"; RT3: parse-validity proves non-garbage, not goodness).

LAYER 1 — MECHANICAL STATE (computed, deterministic; C=repo bytes, R=live bytes, B=baseline bytes; raw SHA-256 + CR-stripped + BOM-stripped normalized hash; mtime shown as a labeled HINT, never a verdict):
- IN-SYNC (R==C) -> silence, earned by state
- BENIGN-DELTA: EOL-ONLY / BOM-ONLY / ENCODING-ONLY (raw differs, normalized equal) -> ignore; measure the phantom rate on the real trees first (CRLF precedent: 16.8% of a fresh clone was phantom drift)
- SOURCE-AHEAD (C!=B, R==B) -> the ONLY state that auto-applies, deploy direction only (dpkg: unmodified file + changed package -> silently replace)
- LIVE-AHEAD (R!=B, C==B) -> renamed to LIVE-EDITED / PROVENANCE-UNKNOWN (never "progress-candidate")
- DIVERGED (R!=B, C!=B, R!=C) -> always park (both-changed is first-class: sync-rules pushes repo->live while sync-from-live pulls the same pair live->repo — verified two-writer overlap)
- ORPHAN-REPO-DELETED / ORPHAN-LIVE-DELETED / LIVE-NEW / REPO-NEW -> never auto-delete; retire-with-quarantine or resurrect only
- Machinery states (never treated as equality): UNREADABLE, LOCKED (sharing violation -> bounded retry then per-file park, run continues: fail-open for the run, fail-closed for the file), REPARSE, CASE-MISMATCH, MANIFEST-SUSPECT (a missing-row flood is machinery-sick, not divergence — RT2 P2)

LAYER 2 — SUGGESTED SEMANTIC CLASS (the owner's taxonomy survives, but machine-labeled SUGGESTED with evidence attached, never self-executing):
- simple-upgrade <- SOURCE-AHEAD with benign history
- progress <- ONLY ever a disposition output, or a suggestion on LIVE-AHEAD carrying quiesce evidence (two-sighting stability >=1h apart, mtime age >=48h, no live agent session on the tree, semantic probe pass — RT2 P1); an agent-authored annotation is always advisory
- regression <- detectable ONLY mechanically: live bytes exactly match a pre-fix repo commit (exact revert in history — C's unique capability), OR repo-side git log shows a fix/revert commit newer than the live edit; otherwise the honest suggestion is unknown
- unknown <- default for DIVERGED and everything unprovable
- other/aux <- the machinery states above

LAYER 3 — DISPOSITION (the reconciling act; records actor identity user-vs-agent, the hash pair, and moves the baseline): adopt-live (B:=R) / keep-source (B:=C after replace) / merge (three-way, B:=merged) / retire-with-quarantine / resurrect / defer(+review-by). Baseline moves ONLY here — B:=C auto on clean deploys (live==base proves live untouched), B:=R only via a disposition act, never a nightly default (RT1 P1; without the state update every keep-live recomputes as divergence forever — the half-finished-migration "corpse"). Agent dispositions pre-fill, never auto-apply; bulk -Apply over divergent items splits into batches (~20) with per-batch confirmation (habituation countermeasure).

GOVERNING RULE (carries the owner's directive verbatim): classification is not reconciliation — no semantic class becomes a write without a disposition act. Both SOTA anchors encode exactly this: dpkg prompts only when BOTH file and package changed (and fails loudly headless rather than silently choosing); Gentoo never touches the live file at all — it stages incoming as ._cfg0000_<name> side-by-side and defers to dispatch-conf, which auto-advances only never-modified files, auto-merges only comment/whitespace diffs, and archives every decision.
headless_default_options: OPTION A (RECOMMENDED) — dpkg confdef+confold analog + Gentoo staging: headless auto-advances only provably-safe states (IN-SYNC, BENIGN-DELTA, SOURCE-AHEAD repo->live — live provably untouched since last reconciliation); every live-diverged pair is staged side-by-side (._cfg0000_-style quarantine/pending), queued as an idempotent register row, exit 2; fold-back (live->repo) is disposition-only AND quiesce-gated (two-sighting + 48h mtime + no live session + semantic probe), landing on a reconciliation branch — never the shared index, so autopush cannot publish it unreviewed; cron wrappers treat exit 2 as success-with-pending and exit 1 (machinery sick) pages differently. UPSIDE: destroy-class dead, deploys never stall, confrontation is persisted state rather than an auto-satisfiable prompt. DOWNSIDE (stated): a standing divergence count becomes the new normal — undispositioned items accumulate (bounded by register cap ~50 + one summary row + weekly triage cadence), and hot agent-edited files can pend for days while their deploys stall (mitigated: severity-A rows + weekly stale-deploy census for PYTHONPATH/executable paths).

OPTION B — full fail-stop (the dpkg-no-policy-in-CI analog): any divergence exits 1 and nothing applies at all. UPSIDE: maximal confrontation, simplest semantics, provably nothing moves unreviewed. DOWNSIDE: nightly deploys stall on the first divergence (the WF-5 stale-executable class returns structurally, invisible to CI); the register still floods; a gate that fires every night trains habituated dismissal — the estate's never-gating-suite rot inverted into always-gating rot.

OPTION C — auto-fold stable live edits (Design B as originally written): headless classifies LIVE-AHEAD as progress and folds live->repo automatically. REJECTED by all three red-teams; RT3 explicitly: without the quiesce/disposition gate the verdict is KILL. It converts a classification guess into an autopushed, cross-machine commit at 3am with zero loud failure — the destroy-class returning through the repo side (it destroys the repo's role as curated truth, so nothing fails red).

OPTION D — agent auto-disposition (LLM classifies AND decides headless): REJECTED as a default. Estate-measured: six Opus agents classifying 338 files hit 86% accuracy with 31 of 47 errors in the data-loss direction (calling DIVERGED files safe), and a prompt is auto-satisfiable by construction (yes(1) semantics). Permitted role: agents PRE-FILL dispositions with evidence and actor identity; a human or the quiesce+evidence gate confirms.

REC: Option A, with Option B's exit-code discipline borrowed for machinery failures (exit 1 vs exit 2 page differently) and Option D allowed only in its pre-fill role. This is also the dpkg-documented unattended recipe translated to trees: --force-confdef (choose the default when one exists) + --force-confold (keep modified without prompting) — auto-advance untouched, keep-and-defer modified.
